title: Beyond Demographic Discrimination: Benchmarking Normative-Descriptive Calibration in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.26870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in socially consequential settings, where they must distinguish between normative reasoning (what should happen) and descriptive reasoning (what is likely to happen). Most fairness benchmarks evaluate demographic discrimination under a single reasoning objective, and none we know of tests whether a model treats the same item differently when asked to describe an outcome versus decide one. We introduce normative--descriptive calibration, the extent to which a model's differentiation between matched candidates depends on whether it is asked to predict or to decide, and measure it with the Normative--Descriptive Calibration Benchmark (NDCB): 697 matched-pair scenarios across six domains, each posed under both framings, and three metrics, Normative Engagement Rate (NER), Normative Leakage Rate (NLR), and Normative--Descriptive Separation (NDS). translated_title: 超越人口统计学歧视：大语言模型中规范-描述校准的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署在具有社会影响的场景中，在这些场景中，它们必须区分规范性推理（应该发生什么）和描述性推理（可能发生什么）。大多数公平性基准仅在单一推理目标下评估人口统计学歧视，而据我们所知，没有任何基准检验模型在被要求“描述”结果与“决定”结果时是否会对同一项目做出不同的处理。我们提出了“规范-描述校准”这一概念，即模型对匹配候选者的区分在多大程度上取决于它是被要求预测还是决策，并通过规范-描述校准基准（NDCB）对其进行测量：该基准包含六个领域的697个匹配对场景，每个场景均以两种框架提出，并采用三个指标：规范参与率（NER）、规范泄漏率（NLR）和规范-描述分离度（NDS）。在六个大语言模型上，NDS能够区分15个（模型-场景组合）中的13个……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“规范-描述校准”这一新概念及包含697个匹配对场景和三个指标（NER、NLR、NDS）的NDCB基准，首次系统衡量大语言模型在“预测结果”与“决策结果”两种任务框架下对相同候选者处理是否一致。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of normative–descriptive calibration and the NDCB benchmark—comprising 697 matched-pair scenarios and three metrics (NER, NLR, NDS)—to systematically measure whether LLMs treat identical candidates differently when asked to predict versus decide outcomes.
